```console
* Tier A (selection by cross-validation with graph-cluster folds + corner loss; lasso/ridge/forest/boosting; optional GNN) runs on a subset of ≈30 cells, ≈100 draws, in a separate stage (`src/gate/tierA.py`), after the Tier-G results are in. Adaptive-threshold HT (Thiyageswaran et al.) is run only if the published rule is available and specifiable.
* Louvain γ rule: three fixed resolutions on every graph; there is no tuned rule.
* Noise draws: one per assignment (not nested), the conditional noise variance being known exactly; graph-draw and assignment-draw variation are nested.

## Revision log
* rev. 0 (this file, before any main run).
* rev. 1 (written while the main runs were still computing; 55 of 104 Tier-G runs existed, and I had looked at a 13-run, mostly p = 0.5 subset
  to debug `analysis/make_diag.py`; no verdict was read from it).
  - Definitions fixed in code for the diagnostic (all in `analysis/make_diag.py`): the reporting specification is `chin`; S = per-draw RMS deviation of
    quad, spline, count, hop2 from chin (`inter` is excluded because it is a different functional family, not a refinement of the exposure map);
    S′ = SD among those four. Corner × curvature C = |mean ĝ''| · mean[(dist_t² + dist_c²)/2] with ĝ'' = 2·(coefficient of f² in `quad`),
    dist_t = 1 − mean f, dist_c = mean f. The half-split is a random half of all (graph, assignment) draws of the cell.
  - Variance part (i): the unit is (run, graph draw, column, noise level, specification in {chin, count, hop2, inter}); target log of the variance of the
    normalised error over the R assignments of that graph draw; predictors log L_spec (+ log n, log σ² as controls); every benchmark gets the same controls
    plus its own feature(s). Held out leave-one-family-out. D = rows from BA, Stanford3, ego-Facebook, degree/community-correlated-baseline runs, cluster
    designs, and every ladder row other than chin; the rest is the tie set.
  - Combined score: log RMSE of the chin estimator per (run, column, m = 0.5) cell with s > 0; predicted = ½ log(V̂ + B̂²), V̂ from the part-(i) log-linear
    model on log L and B̂ = NNLS on (S̄, C) fitted to |bias| of the other random half, both fitted on the training groups. Benchmarks: OLS of log RMSE on
    log n, log σ² and one of log d, log p(1−p), log[n p(1−p)/d]. The bootstrap-SE and Han–Ugander-CV benchmarks are compared only on the cells that have
    them (runs with B > 0 for the bootstrap SE; the Tier A subset for the CV loss) and said so.
  - **Added after seeing the partial look, labelled exploratory**: the pre-registered S at σ = 0.5 was nearly the same in every cell (≈ 0.27–0.30 in the
    SBM core cell) whatever the bias, i.e. it is dominated by the outcome-noise spread of the higher-leverage ladder specifications. Two variants are
    therefore reported next to it and never in place of it: S_adj (S² minus the null-simulation expectation of its noise part, the null being column 0 of
    the same run — correct specification, same graph, design and noise — scaled by the ratio of the noise variances) and S_sig (S from the signal part only,
    σ = 0: the ceiling of what specification disagreement could carry). Acceptance is judged on the pre-registered rows only.
  - Bias prediction (`analysis/predict_bias.py`): exact for (a), (b), (e) on the realised graph (population OLS from traces of M and W), exact Binomial mixture
    for (c), (d), closed form for (f); compared to the realised bias of `chin`.
  - Departure: the SBM implemented is the plain equal-block SBM (block size 100), not degree-corrected; degree heterogeneity comes from BA, Stanford3 and
    ego-Facebook only. Part (i) D-set evidence therefore rests on those three families plus the baseline-correlated and cluster runs.

Nothing more is owed from me this turn. `analysis` has settled everything I asked for in `experiment-repo`#4, in plan rev. 1 and its addendum.

I checked the plan against the outline. The fine s grid, the cluster designs on weak SBM and the real graphs, the DC-SBM cells, the convex mirror, the n slice, and HC0 coverage on all draws are all in the cell list.

No results exist yet, because the main runs are still computing, so I have no claim to revise. I'm leaving the request open and waiting for results. When they land, I'll update Outline rev 5 claim by claim.
